title: Custom Equipment on Kept Total-Loss Vehicles: Decision Table, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Rule.** On a total-loss vehicle the customer keeps under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, where the vehicle could be driven after the loss and the estimate total is below 80 percent of the actual cash value, the custom equipment stays usable on the kept vehicle and no retained-equipment payment is made; where the vehicle could be driven and the estimate total is at or above that share, 50 percent of the documented custom equipment up to the limit is paid; where the vehicle could not be driven, the documented custom equipment is paid up to the limit in full. The limit is the deductible option's custom equipment limit, and the payment is rounded to the cent.

Whether the vehicle could be driven is read from the claim's loss report; the estimate total, the actual cash value and the documented custom equipment from the claim's total-loss declaration.

| Could be driven after the loss | Estimate total against 80 percent of the actual cash value | Retained-equipment payment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Below | None; the equipment stays usable on the vehicle |
| Yes | At or above | 50 percent of the documented equipment up to the limit |
| No | Any | The documented equipment up to the limit, in full |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Actual cash value 12000.00; 80 percent of it is 9600.00. Documented custom equipment 2000.00 under an option whose limit is 1500.
- Drivable, estimate 9599.99: no payment.
- Drivable, estimate 9600.00: 50 percent of 1500.00, that is 750.00.
- Not drivable: 1500.00.
- Documented equipment 900.00, drivable, estimate 10000.00: 50 percent of 900.00, that is 450.00.
